name: Cryptek
equipped_with: A Cryptek is equipped with: -.A Chronomancer is equipped with: Aeonstave. A Dynasty Scion is equipped with: -.A Psychomancer is equipped with: Abyssal lance. A Plasmancer is equipped with: Plasmic lance. An Ethermancer is equipped with: Voltaic staff. A Geomancer is equipped with: Tremorstave. An Astromancer is equipped with: Staff of Time. A Technomancer is equipped with: Staff of Light.

weapons.name: Abyssal lance
weapons.abilities: Wound rolls are done against the target's Leadership value. Successfull wounds cause one Mortal Wound each.

option_groups.header: Must be upgraded to one of the following. Each specialisation is unique per army

choices.name: Dynasty Scion
abilities: Dynasty Scion: The model gains an improved profile (see above) and has additionally access to Lord equipment in the Armory.

choices.name: Astromancer
abilities: Astromancer: Prescient strike grants this model 2 re-rolls each. Additionally, this model's rolls for "The Stars Are Right" are always reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

choices.name: Chronomancer
abilities: Chronomancer: A Chronometron's ability may be used for this model or its attached unit. Additionally, a Timesplinter mantle grants "Deflect" and "Parry" to this model and its attached unit.

choices.name: Ethermancer
abilities: Ethermancer: An Ether crystal used by this model causes 2D3 hits. Additionally, this model's Lightning Field grants the "Retribution(1)" ability to its attached unit.

choices.name: Technomancer
abilities: Technomancer: A Canoptek Cloak used by this model may repair 2 Wounds or 2 vehicle damage results per turn. Additionally, it may use a Canoptek Control Node a second time each activation.

choices.name: Geomancer
abilities: Geomancer: A Harp of Dissonance used by this model has unlimited range. Additionally, a Seismic crucible grants its effect to this model and its attached unit.

choices.name: Plasmancer
abilities: Plasmancer: A Gaze of Flame's effect may be used for this model and its attached unit. Additionally, this model and its attached unit are not affected by a Solar Pulse.

choices.name: Psychomancer
abilities: Psychomancer: A Nightmare Shroud increases its radius to 18" for this model. Additionally, a Veil of Darkness scatters 1D6 less (so normally only 1D6") when used by this model.
